lines.en: It scurries on its toes in quick little steps.
Its long tail counterbalances each turn.
It pokes its head forward at every step.
Those thin legs are faster than they look.

lines.zh: 它从一丛草窜到另一丛
lines.en: It darts from one tuft to the next.
It slips low through the gravel.
Its claws find good grip.

lines.zh: 它跑两步就回头看一眼
lines.en: Two strides, then a glance back.
It loops half around a bush.
Its tread on dry twigs is tiny.

lines.zh: 它沿着一道土坡向下跑
lines.en: It runs down a low bank.

lines.zh: 它忽然刹住，扬起一点土
lines.en: It brakes, kicking up a little dust.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一甩就换了方向
lines.en: A tail flick and it changes course.
It squeezes through a gap in the rocks.
It runs low and easy to miss.
It runs a stretch, then stops to listen.
It stands, head bobbing.

lines.zh: 它在沙土里扒了个浅坑
lines.en: It scrapes a shallow pit in the dust.
It settles in and starts dust-bathing.
Its feathers fluff out.
It cocks its head at the sky.
Its tail sways gently.
A claw scratches its neck.

lines.zh: 它忽然一动不动，像根木桩
lines.en: It freezes like a stake.
Then it relaxes again.

lines.zh: 它低头啄了啄自己的胸羽
lines.en: It pecks at its breast feathers.
Its breathing is light and quick.

lines.zh: 它抬头警觉地望了一圈
lines.en: It lifts its head and scans around.
It settles into another crouch.

lines.zh: 羽毛从它身上飘下来一根
lines.en: A feather drifts loose from it.
It snaps its head toward you.
Its whole body goes taut.
Side-on, it watches you with one eye.
It backs off two short steps.
It ducks its head, ready to run.

lines.zh: 它又停下来，忍不住好奇
lines.en: Then it stops, too curious to flee.
It stretches its neck to sniff.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴在身后紧张地摆
lines.en: Its tail flicks nervously.
It pecks the ground suddenly.
It looks a heartbeat from bolting.
It shrieks and springs away.
Feathers loosen only in a dust bath.
It runs a few paces and stops.
It stands crooked, unsteady.

lines.zh: 它躲进草里，只露出尾尖
lines.en: It hides in the grass, tail tip only.
Its breathing is frantic.
It props itself up on one leg.
A small wound, but the blood shows.
It calls twice, faintly.
It trembles and watches you.

lines.zh: 它朝你手里的东西探头
lines.en: It cranes toward what you hold.

lines.zh: 它绕着你的手走了半圈
lines.en: It circles your hand half way.
It snatches a bite and retreats.
It eats with its head coming up.
It pecks too fast and drops crumbs.
Fed, it comes back for more.
Even its tail lifts.

lines.zh: 它把食物甩了两下才吞
lines.en: It shakes the food before swallowing.

lines.zh: 它警惕地看着你的另一只手
lines.en: It keeps an eye on your other hand.

lines.zh: 它在你脚边转着找碎屑
lines.en: It circles your feet for crumbs.
It hops half a step clear.
It nearly trips on landing.

lines.zh: 它转身就跑，跑两步又停
lines.en: It runs, then stops after two strides.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛被碰得立起来
lines.en: Its feathers ruffle up.
It darts between your legs.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在你鞋上刮了一下
lines.en: A claw scrapes your shoe.
It steadies and shakes itself.
It backs away, still watching.
It makes no sound, only grows warier.
Its tail feathers lower slightly.
Two of them stand head to head.
One trots a circle around the other.
They peck lightly at each other's necks.
Their tails run nearly parallel.

lines.zh: 它们同时抬头看同一个方向
lines.en: Both lift their heads the same way.

lines.zh: 一只趴下，另一只守在旁边
lines.en: One settles while the other stands by.

lines.zh: 它们把身体靠在一起取暖
lines.en: They press together for warmth.
Their feathers overlap.

lines.zh: 它们安静得像两块石头
lines.en: They go still as two stones.

lines.zh: 远处有动静，它们同时抬头
lines.en: A sound; both heads come up.
It pecks the food up.
It shakes the dirt off.
It carries it off behind the grass.
A claw pins it, then it pecks.
It swallows fast.

lines.zh: 它啄起碎屑，一粒都不剩
lines.en: It takes every crumb.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西甩头
lines.en: What it dislikes, it shakes away.
It drops and picks it back up.
It looks up to check nothing is stealing.
After eating it preens.
It freezes all at once.

lines.zh: 它的头偏到一侧，盯着你
lines.en: Its head cants, fixed on you.
Its tail feathers flare.
It has labelled you a predator.
It backs a step, then another.
Its legs are already half bent.
It lets out a short alarm call.
It starts hunting for an exit.
Its breathing is visibly fast.
It is a breath from bolting.

lines.zh: 它选择了背离你的方向
lines.en: It picks the direction away from you.
It gives you one last look.
It runs and keeps looking back.
It picks routes under the bushes.
It keeps to the edge of the bank.
Then it changes direction sharply.
It crouches motionless behind a stone.
Only the top of its head shows.
You move; it ducks back.
It starts running in a circle.
It is trying to lose you.
Its tail stays stiff.
It gets further with every stride.
Then it stops dead.

lines.zh: 大概它以为已经安全了
lines.en: It must think it is safe now.
It hops and pecks your ankle.
Its claws claw at your shoe.
It tugs your trouser leg with its beak.
It bumps your shin, light as a bird.
One peck and it withdraws.
It is so scared its feathers all stand.
It charges again, more frantic.
Its tail thrashes.
A small beak, but a solid grip.
It retreats, calling shakily.
It flaps up at you in a flurry.

lines.zh: 它啄了你的手指，然后逃走
lines.en: It pecks your finger and flees.
The grass stirs.
It pokes its head out through the blades.
Its long tail shows first.

lines.zh: 它小跑着到了空地边缘
lines.en: It trots to the edge of the open ground.
It stops and looks around.
Grass seed clings to its feathers.
It shakes itself out.
It pecks at the ground once.
It edges two steps further.
Its shadow on the dirt is small.
It suddenly turns to look at you.
It does not run at once.
First it judges the distance.
Then it begins to back away.

lines.zh: 羽毛被燎到，它疯狂扑打
lines.en: Singed feathers send it thrashing.
It lands and tumbles head over heels.
In water it thrashes hard.
The blast tossed me into the shrubs.

lines.zh: 箭擦过它的背，带走了羽
lines.en: An arrow grazes its back and takes feathers.
Odd force makes it convulse.
Starving, it trembles and sways.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵住，羽毛全立
lines.en: Lightning locks it stiff, feathers up.
The void pulls; its legs kick wildly.
